tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, free grid cells, inputs, the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Segmented control track and chat-bubble grey; never a text ground for muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper and surface (16:1); primary buttons; the best-time card; selected chips; focus ring.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and hour labels on paper (5.0:1), surface and track (4.6:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only; it carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: 1px border that identifies a control: free grid cells, unselected chips and inputs (3.4:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on paper).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Your own hours, selected dates, the wordmark's mark. A fill, never text; ink text on it reads 5.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon on paper and surface (5.2:1): links, eyebrows.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink, inside the best-time card (10:1).

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Share free up to 20%. Count in ink.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Share free up to 40%. Count in ink.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Share free up to 60%. Count in ink. Also the count text inside the ink best-time card (9.3:1).

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Share free up to 80%. Count in ink (6.7:1).

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Share free above 80%. Count in white (4.8:1).

tokens.name: tint-coral
tokens.usage: Avatar ground, picked from the normalised name.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: Avatar ground.

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: Avatar ground.

tokens.name: tint-butter
tokens.usage: Avatar ground.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar ground; initials in ink on every tint (13:1 or more).

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: best-time
styles.usage: The best time inside its ink card.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: Date number in the grid header.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The product name in the header.

styles.name: display-8xl
styles.usage: Landing section headlines on desktop (text-8xl); text-5xl on the phone.

styles.name: display-9xl
styles.usage: The landing hero and quote on desktop (text-9xl); text-5xl and text-6xl on the phone.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, inputs (16px keeps iOS from zooming).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Labels, meta lines, hour labels, weekdays.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-cell-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between grid cells; the tap-safe gutter.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips and between avatars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on the phone; side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side padding on the phone; best-time card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on the phone.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Grid cells.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the best-time card, the bottom sheet's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, the segment track.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The selected segment only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet; the only shadow on the poll pages.

tokens.name: shadow-poster
tokens.usage: Poster cards, link cards and the try-it board on the landing (ADR 0034).

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Every button's ledge (ADR 0035), ink by default; a shadow colour utility recolours it (heat-5 under ink buttons, accent under light buttons on ink).

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-up
tokens.usage: The ledge under a hovered button, lifted 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-down
tokens.usage: The ledge under a pressed button, dropped 6px.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-sm
tokens.usage: The ledge under small buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-sm-up
tokens.usage: The small ledge under a hovered small button.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-sm-down
tokens.usage: The small ledge under a pressed small button or chip.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: Grid cell height on the phone; width at least 56px.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Button height on the phone; 40px on desktop.

tokens.name: duration-fill
tokens.usage: A tapped cell's fill and press scale.

tokens.name: duration-bump
tokens.usage: A heat cell whose count rises.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: The bottom sheet sliding up.

tokens.name: duration-pop
tokens.usage: A new respondent's avatar popping in.

tokens.name: duration-turn
tokens.usage: A turn between two states: a poster flipping to its time, a question opening or closing.

tokens.name: duration-swing
tokens.usage: A short springy change: a swapped word, the best-time pulse, a wordmark tile lighting.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: A card arriving, and posters following the pointer.

tokens.name: duration-burst
tokens.usage: A tile burst flying out.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: One sway of a drifting poster.

tokens.name: duration-marquee
tokens.usage: One loop of the poster wall's front lane.

tokens.name: duration-marquee-slow
tokens.usage: One loop of the poster wall's back lane.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that moves into place.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Avatar pop only; the one overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A swapped word and an arriving card; landing only.

tokens.name: ease-sway
tokens.usage: Idle drift, there and back.
